Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Gwen Morse wrote:
> Mostly, it's supposed to revolve around calling votes people won't
> want to see called, and so they block them, to end up in Agg combat.
> If what I'm reading on the card text is right, then, Carrion Crows
> does damage even if Dodge/S:CE is played. If that's NOT true, then,
> the whole thing falls apart.

It's only half true. Carrion Crows deals damage during strike resoltion.
The damage isn't from a strike, so won't be circumvented by a Dodge.
But it does occur only during strike resolution, so S:CE will preclude
that damage.

Add in some Drawing Out the Beasts and (at superior) you'll have your
"damage to the S:CE'er".
